content.text:
Confirmed: prior to 72940a4, `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter)` was called unconditionally right after `gridview` assignment in `onCreateView`. Commit 72940a4 removed that unconditional call and relocated `setAdapter` into the `runOnUiThread` block inside `getMovies()`'s response listener — which only executes when movies are freshly fetched (`movies.size() == 0`). On any subsequent `onCreateView` call where `updateUI()` takes the `resetImageAdapter()` path instead (movies already cached), the adapter is never attached to the newly created `gridview`, leaving the GridView blank. The fix commit 8e40fb2 restores the unconditional `setAdapter` call in `onCreateView`, exactly undoing the regression from 72940a4.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 72940a4d8845f4690a5910f61c618c067d22c287

## Reasoning
(1) I traced the history of `MainActivityFragment.java` with `git log -p --follow`, grepping for `imageAdapter`/`setAdapter` occurrences across commits to see how the adapter-attachment logic evolved leading up to the fix.
(2) At the immediate parent of the fix (`efd83a2`), `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter)` only existed inside a `runOnUiThread` callback nested in the Volley response listener of `getMovies()`. This callback only fires when `getMovies()` is actually called, i.e. when `movies.size() == 0` (first load). When `onCreateView` runs again (e.g., after a config change) and `movies` is already populated, `updateUI()` instead calls `resetImageAdapter()`, which never touches `gridview.setAdapter(...)` — so the newly recreated `GridView` never gets an adapter and would render empty.
(3) Examining commit `72940a4d8845f4690a5910f61c618c067d22c287`'s diff shows it explicitly removed the line `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` that previously ran unconditionally right after `gridview` was assigned in `onCreateView` (present in the prior commit `d82256d`), and moved the call into the async `runOnUiThread` block instead. This is precisely the regression that the bug-fix commit `8e40fb2` reverses by re-adding the unconditional `gridview.setAdapter(imageAdapter);` line in `onCreateView`.

I'm confident in this identification — the fix is a near-exact re-insertion of the line removed in `72940a4`, and no other commit in the history touches this adapter-attachment logic in a way that would produce the same missing-adapter symptom.
